AllowedExample.description:
A public project function that does what a contract report shows from a place its contract
allows, and the file defining it (the report's help names it).

path.description: The file that defines it, as reports print paths.

candidates.description: How many functions the call may run.

depth.description: The level: 1 for a direct caller.

in_loop.description: Whether the call is in a loop.

path.description: The file of the call, relative to the project root.

role.description: What the caller does with the result: `call`, `property`, `iterate`, `return`, or `through`.

via.description: The function it calls, for a caller above the direct ones.

depth.description: How many levels of callers are listed.

truncated.description: Whether `entries` lists fewer than there are.

Candidate.description: A function to choose from: its name, where it is defined, and its kind.

kind.description: The kind of function: `method` (the name has a class) or `function`.

line.description: The line of its definition; none when heki could not find it.

path.description: The file, relative to the project root; none when no file of the project defines it.

Certainty.description:
Whether a report can be wrong about the code (ADR-018). A report's claim is a conjunction of
premises (its rule page lists them under "What a report states").

oneOf.description:
Every premise of the claim was established, under the assumptions R1-R5, and the rule's
reports were checked on the measurement corpus with none wrong: a wrong one is a bug.

A premise of the claim may be unknown, which does not stop the report: it can be wrong
about the code.

class_attrs.description: The attributes of classes it writes; none when heki does not follow typed writes.

class_attrs_needs.description: Why `class_attrs` is none: what turns the analysis on.

globals.description: The module globals and closure variables it changes.

invalidates.description: What it invalidates under an `invalidation` contract.

params.description: What the function changes of its parameters.

class.description: The qualified name of the class.

entries_only.description:
Whether every write changes one of `keys`: none changes the container as a whole
(`extras.clear()` next to `extras["init"] = v` does).

fresh.description: Whether the written object is new in the function.

keys.description:
The entries of the attribute's container the function's own and passed item writes
change: `"init"` for a constant key, the parameter's name for a key its callers pass
(`key`), `?` for a key heki cannot tell.

Condition.description: The name looked up equals the function's name.

equals.description: The name the function is selected by.

others_open.description: The name is not a constant: other names may select other functions, or none.

selector.description:
The expression the name is computed from, in the values the row's call passes, or the
constant.

roles.description: What the function is in the contract, for instance `allowed-writer` or `reported`.

Docs.description: The page of the documentation, or the section of one, that explains it.

blocking.description: Whether it blocks the event loop.

chain.description: The calls from the function to the effect.

direct.description: Whether the function has it itself, not only through a callee.

effect.description: The effect, by its name in the catalogs (`blocking_net`).

guards.description: The tests that decide whether the effect happens.

once_per.description: The parameters the effect happens once per item of; none when it does not.

via_subclasses.description:
The subclasses whose methods have the effect, run only when a parameter is an instance
of one.

Entry.description: One element of the JSON output: a report, or the error object of a symbol.

ErrorBody.description: What a symbol that names no single function got instead.

candidates.description: With `kind` `ambiguous`: the functions the symbol may name.

docs.description: The page of the documentation that explains it.

errors.description: With `kind` `unknown`: the files heki could not analyze.

functions.description: With `kind` `module`: the top-level functions of the module.

help.description: What to do about it, one step per entry.

kind.description:
`invalid` (the symbol does not parse), `outside_project` (it names a file heki did not
check), `unknown`, `ambiguous`, `class`, or `module`.

message.description: What is wrong with the symbol.

methods.description: With `kind` `class`: the methods of the class.

suggestions.description: With `kind` `unknown`: the functions with similar names.

truncated.description: Whether the list the failure carries is cut short.

class.description: The qualified name of its class; none for a function outside a class.

definitions.description: The first line of every definition (`if ...: def f` / `else: def f`).

driven_synchronously.description: Whether a caller drives the coroutine to its end without an event loop.

end_line.description: The last line of the first definition.

line.description: The first line of the first definition.

offloaded_by.description: The call that runs it in a thread or process pool; none when no call does.

path.description: The file, relative to the project root.

stub.description: Whether only a stub file declares it.

cell_of.description: The function whose variable the closure cell is (`None`: a module global).

chain.description: The calls from the function to the change.

direct.description: Whether the function changes it itself, not only through a callee.

attr.description: The attribute of the parameter the test is about; none for the parameter itself.

holds.description: Whether the effect happens when the test holds.

param.description: The parameter the test is about.

Hop.description:
One hop of a call chain: the call at `path:line` of the hop before it (the function itself
for the first) calls `calls`, one of `candidates` the call may run.

calls.description: The function the call runs, or the first of its candidates.

candidates.description: How many functions the call may run.

path.description: The file of the call, relative to the project root.

InspectError.description:
The object `heki inspect --output-format json` prints for a symbol that names no single
function (an array of reports and these objects for `-`).

error.description: Why the symbol names no function.

query.description: The symbol, as it was given.

complete.description: Whether every file of the project was analyzed: false when `errors` is not empty.

contracts.description: The roles the function has in the declared contracts.

effects.description: The effects the function has, directly or through the functions it calls.

errors.description: The files heki could not read or parse.

heki.description: The version of heki that wrote the report.

only_reads.description: The container parameters the function only reads.

purity.description: Whether the function is pure, and why heki cannot tell.

query.description: The symbol, as it was given.

registered.description: The registrations that may reach the function with a parameter bound to the registering object.

reports.description: The reports of `heki check` in the function, and with `--callers` those above it.

resolved_from.description: How the symbol named the function: `name` (a dotted suffix), `glob`, `suffix`, or `line` (`path.py:LINE`); none for an exact fully qualified name.

root.description: The project root, as `heki check` prints paths.

path.description: The file, relative to the project root.

OnlyReads.description:
The parameters annotated with a mutable container (`list`, `dict`, `set`, their `typing`
forms, `MutableSequence`, `MutableMapping`, `MutableSet`), and what the function does with
them (`heki_effect::ContainerParams`).

bound_once.description: Those whose name the function binds once (`if p is None: p = []` aside).

containers.description: The parameters annotated with a mutable container.

params.description:
Those the function only reads: it and every function it hands one to neither change it
in place nor keep it (store, capture, yield, or return it), and every call it is handed
to resolves to such a function or to a library call Layer 1 lists as reading it.

read_only_uses.description:
Those whose every use in the function's own body the read-only type (`Sequence`,
`Mapping`, `AbstractSet`) allows.

reads.description:
By parameter the function only reads, annotated or not, the kinds of read that reach its
object here and in the functions it is handed to (`heki_effect::ReadKinds`): `item
access`, `iteration`, ..., then the methods called by name.

elements_of.description: The parameters whose items it may be.

held.description: Whether it may be an object something else holds.

new.description: Whether it may be a new object.

at.description: Where the change is; none when it is in a callee.

chain.description: The calls from the function to the change.

direct.description: Whether the function changes it itself, not only through a callee.

slots.description: The keys or attributes changed, as `a` or `["k"]`.

assumes.description: The assumptions the verdict rests on.

because.description: Why the verdict is `unknown`: `unresolved_calls`, `untracked_writes`, or `no_body`; for `impure`, the effects found.

unknown_at.description: The first entry of `unknown_reach`, whatever the verdict.

RegisteredContext.description:
A registration that may reach the function with one of its parameters bound to the
registering object, under the condition the name a lookup selects the function by meets
(`heki_effect::dispatch`). Advisory: no other fact, report, or fix assumes it.

called_at.description: The call of the registered slot of the table's row.

changes.description:
What the function changes of the parameter under the context: its `changes.params`
record with the parameter of that type (empty: no change).

param.description: The parameter bound to the registering object.

registration.description: The factory call of the registration, in the function registering.

selected_at.description: The lookup by name, and the call of what it finds.

type.description: The registering object's class, the parameter's type under the context.

RelatedLocation.description: Related jump location (e.g., each hop in an `EFF101` or `MUT201` call chain for LSP).

message.description: What the location is: the call of a hop, for instance.

path.description: The file, as reports print paths.

span.description: Byte span in `path` (the LSP server converts it with the file's own text).

Report.description: A diagnostic of `heki check` with what the baseline makes of it and where it is.

allowed_examples.description:
The public project functions that do what a contract report shows from a place its
contract allows, at most three, by fully qualified name: its help names them. Empty for the other
reports and when there is none; written to JSON only when not empty.

blocker.description: What keeps the rewrite of an `OPT` report from being safe; none otherwise.

certainty.description:
The certainty of the report, written by every output format: its rule's, or heuristic
where the report did not establish a premise its rule's exact reports have (an `OPT`
report whose rewrite is not proven).

column.description: The 1-based byte column of the report.

evidence.description: What shows the claim holds, when the rule keeps it.

fix.description: The edits of the report's fix, as byte spans of `path`; none when the report has no fix.

help.description:
What to do about it (`= help:` in the full output); `None` when the rule has no advice
for the report.

message.description: One sentence saying what happens, without advice.

path.description:
The file, as `heki check` prints paths: relative to the working directory, with forward
slashes.

qualname.description: The qualified name of the function the report is in; empty at module level.

related.description: The other places the report is about: the hops of a call chain, a definition.

rule_code.description: The code of the rule that reports (`EFF101`).

severity.description: The severity of the report, from its rule or the configuration.

sites.description:
Distinct violation sites the diagnostic stands for (at least 1): a contract report at the
caller of a private helper covers every write, read, or call inside it, and an effect
boundary report every forbidden site its scope function reaches. Ratchet baselines count
sites, so a second violation behind a recorded report is a regression. Written to JSON
only when above 1.

span.description: The byte span of the reported code in `path`.

target.description: What the report is about: the call, name, or module it names.

where.description: `in` the function, or in a caller and `through` it.

kept.description: The parameters it keeps (stores, captures, yields, or returns); none without an ownership contract.

kept_needs.description: Why `kept` is none: what turns the analysis on.

iterated_effects.description: The effects iterating the returned object has.

new_object.description: Whether it is a new object: `own`, `copy`, or `no`; none without an ownership contract.

origins.description: Where the returned object comes from; none when heki does not know.

shared_with.description: The producer whose read-only object it returns; none otherwise.

at.description: Where the change is; none when it is in a callee.

chain.description: The calls from the function to the change.

direct.description: Whether the function changes it itself, not only through a callee.

key.description: The constant key changed within the attribute; none for the attribute itself.

chain.description: The calls from the function to it.

producer.description: The function that produces the read-only object.

function.description: The function the site is in.

path.description: The file, relative to the project root.

Span.description: Byte-offset span in the original Python source file.

end.description: The offset after the last byte.

start.description: The offset of the first byte.

also.description:
The other parameters that must be instances of subclasses for the chain to run: a
subclass's method reaching the method another subclass gives a call on a second
parameter.

chain.description: The calls from the function to the effect through it.

param.description: The parameter the subclass's method is called on (`self` for the method's own).
The parameter the subclass's method is called on.

TextEdit.description: Minimal byte-span text edit (preserves formatting and comments).

replacement.description: The text that takes their place.

chain.description: The calls from the function to it.

UnknownReach.description:
The functions heki cannot follow (calls it cannot resolve, or a body only a stub declares)
among the function and the callees whose facts run in it, nearest first.

truncated.description: More functions are reached than `entries` lists.

description: `heki inspect` prints one report or error, or with `-` an array of them.
title: heki inspect --output-format json
